notes: Three evaluations for changing formlit's code, and a trigger set whose negatives are using formlit on photos (formlit-driving) and the form family's neighbours. Expected behaviours are observable in the transcript or the repository.

evals.name: add-an-engine-command-and-mcp-tool
evals.prompt: Add a way to set the copyright line on many photos at once in formlit, and make sure agents can use it too.
expected_behavior: Adds a mutating command in backend/app/engine/cmd_library.py with params matching the signature and the write inside one catalog.change

Adds a curated tool in backend/app/routers/mcp.py calling the command, leaves it behind the outside-agent consent gate with no exemption, then runs ./formlit agents sync and ./formlit agents sync --check
Proves it with ./formlit cli and reverses it with edit.undo
Edits existing files with single-region hand edits only, adds no code comments, and records the decision in backend/HASHOUT_LOG.md
Commits as nodemode-ai with a Conventional Commit carrying the version

evals.name: fix-a-flash-in-an-output-module
evals.prompt: The Print module flickers every time I drag the margin slider, the whole page blinks white. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Routes to ui-builder and states the three-line pre-write for the DOM change
Keeps PageView cells and images in place (patchList, src only when changed) instead of rebuilding the page
Runs npx tsc --noEmit and verifies under 4x CPU and network throttling, or says plainly it did not
Does not touch the engine's layout command unless the layout itself was wrong

evals.name: change-what-a-blocked-agent-is-told
evals.prompt: When AI agents are turned off in formlit, the message the agent gets should also say how to turn them back on. Change that.
expected_behavior: Finds the message in backend/app/engine/agents.py and changes it with one single-region hand edit, keeping the words Preferences, AI agents and the instruction not to retry
Reads backend/HASHOUT_LOG.md first and records the decision there, with no comment added to the code
Proves it by setting outsideAgents to blocked and calling a tool through the MCP endpoint or the stdio bridge, and reading the refusal, or says plainly it did not
Leaves the window and the REST commands ungated
